briefdescription.para: Demonstrates Advanced Sector Protection (ASP) using the SFL library.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains a design example using the serial flash library (SFL) for ASP on serial NOR flash. It interacts over stdin. It selects an ASP operation ID and optionally programs the password or nonvolatile (NV) sector locks. It also unlocks NV lock bits and prints the NV lock status for a sector range.

The same example covers both quad (QSPI, 4-4-4) and octal (OSPI, 8-8-8) NOR flash devices. The library drives both through the OSPI controller. The ASP layer selects the command framing and dummy cycles from the detected flash make. This example has been tested with the Micron Octal Serial Flash (MT35XU02GCBA).

simplesect.para: The example uses console I/O (scanf). Password buffers stay on the stack only. This example requires the BSP setting xilsfl_CONFIG_ADVANCED_SECTOR_PROTECTION=true.
